title: Connect and Reason

voice.baseline_approval: Owner approved calibration 2ff0ffce and reports all five current Measurement videos have excellent audio delivery
voice.accent: Natural slight Indian-English; perception must be verified, not inferred from an identifier
voice.enhanced_delivery_limitation: Installed engine reproduces approved baseline, but no dedicated emotion/emphasis control has been demonstrated. A modest increase from native punctuation/context needs a short actual listening calibration; do not use rate/volume/pitch effects as a substitute.

pause_policy: Original scene/prediction starts retained. Native speech synthesis only. Caption-end corrections are at most0.25seconds and never overlap the next utterance.
